claims.text: The best performance on the CNSS dataset in terms of F1-score is achieved by the model variant 'XVIII. CIG-Sim&Siam-GCN-Simg&BERTg', with an F1-score of 90.29.
The key components of the model 'XVIII. CIG-Sim&Siam-GCN-Simg&BERTg' include a Siamese encoder, context layers, matching layers, and a term-based feature extractor.
